activity: Confirm canonical SO1–SO3 and thermal state/time boundary
method_or_specific_action: Use frozen scope; don't revive historical broad H1–H5 as current authorities.
acceptance_criterion: Exact objective wording plus included/excluded interfaces and service consequences recorded.

activity: Prepare full review protocol based on existing V1
method_or_specific_action: Adapt approved PRISMA-P/ScR reporting as appropriate; version all protocol amendments.
acceptance_criterion: Review type, questions, eligibility, planned databases, synthesis and deviations documented.

activity: Obtain search-logic review (PRESS)
method_or_specific_action: Seek information-specialist/independent review; if unavailable disclose self-review rather than invent a second reviewer.
acceptance_criterion: Named reviewer/date/checklist or explicit self-review limitation; revisions retained.

activity: Freeze searchable protocol and planned update rule
method_or_specific_action: Archive protocol timestamp; record optional public registration only if authorized; preserve all subsequent amendments.
acceptance_criterion: Pre-search version immutable with hash; approval and dates traceable; no false registration claim.

activity: Set reference and source repository
method_or_specific_action: Set up Zotero/BibTeX/RIS with DOI normalization, filename convention, folder permissions and bibliography style.
acceptance_criterion: References, publisher PDFs, original search exports and derived extracts distinguished; access/licence documented.

activity: Translate Q1–Q7 to database-specific syntax
method_or_specific_action: Search broad synonyms and foundational laws beyond EV-only queries; run pilot recall/precision checks.
acceptance_criterion: Queries reproduce concept families; no query is curated solely to recover known papers.

activity: Record platform access and coverage
method_or_specific_action: Check Scopus, WoS, IEEE, Engineering Village and supported complements; distinguish inaccessible databases.
acceptance_criterion: Every target platform marked SEARCHED/UNAVAILABLE/PENDING with no fabricated coverage.

activity: Execute de novo bibliographic searches
method_or_specific_action: Run exact queries per accessible platform, with dates, years, filters, counts, DOI/BibTeX/RIS exports.
acceptance_criterion: Each actual search has full query, UTC date, filters, platform, count and file SHA256.

activity: Quality-check original exports and metadata
method_or_specific_action: Audit empty/broken searches, encoding, identifier/title/author/year/venue and recall diagnostics.
acceptance_criterion: Reported results can be traced to original exports and platform-specific searches.

activity: Conduct backward/forward citation chasing and grey literature
method_or_specific_action: Track technical projects, standards and publisher references as additional-source routes, not database records.
acceptance_criterion: Seed, link direction, source, date, identifiers and inclusion route individually preserved.

activity: Plan final search update near submission
method_or_specific_action: Perform a dated versioned update, screen new records, show separately in flow counts.
acceptance_criterion: Update time and additions traceable; no undocumented corpus replacement.

activity: Deduplicate citations
method_or_specific_action: Match DOI, title+author+year then manually adjudicate ambiguous records; preserve link to each source export.
acceptance_criterion: Every removed duplicate traced; record vs study counts reconciled.

activity: Screen titles and abstracts
method_or_specific_action: Use prespecified inclusion/exclusion and six evidence strata F1–F6; record decision/status/reason.
acceptance_criterion: Every record has reviewer, decision and reason; AI is not represented as human second reviewer.

activity: Retrieve authoritative full texts
method_or_specific_action: Find publisher/author PDF and supplementary data for potential inclusions; mark access failures honestly.
output: Full text acquisition and access log
acceptance_criterion: Every included study has full text or AWAITING_FULLTEXT; source version/page references recorded.

activity: Resolve conflicts and full-text eligibility
method_or_specific_action: Independent reviewer if available; if not, report single reviewer and verify critical decisions.
acceptance_criterion: Study-based exclusion codes and resolution history; no silent auto-inclusion.

activity: Generate PRISMA numbers and flow only from records
method_or_specific_action: Count exports, duplicates, exclusions, full texts, included studies and source-specific additions.
acceptance_criterion: Integer arithmetic reconciles to source ledger; no invented denominators.

activity: Extract transformer physical laws and parameter provenance
method_or_specific_action: From primary text extract hot spot/top oil, thermal time constants, loss heat balances, ratings and BC/IC.
acceptance_criterion: Equation/page/variable/units/parameter origin and validation status per evidence unit.

activity: Extract EVSE and battery thermo-electrical mechanisms
method_or_specific_action: Separate rectifier heat sink/coolant, battery, charger AC/DC boundaries, ambient, cooling control and derating reasons.
acceptance_criterion: Measured sensor locations, units, timebase and thermal-cause observations explicitly distinguished.

activity: Extract directional connected-system claims
method_or_specific_action: Verify transformer→bus→EVSE topology and P→Te / Te→P mechanism, control, heat confounding and service.
acceptance_criterion: Each direction has physical mapping, measured inputs/receiver, competing causes and proof limits.

activity: Audit physics-informed ML and PINNs
method_or_specific_action: Extract observed-vs-collocation training data, residual PDE, optimization, data amounts, baselines and heldouts.
acceptance_criterion: No experimental-grounding claim without independent observed target states.

activity: Extract resilience/service metrics and time semantics
method_or_specific_action: Identify actual or modeled transition time, propagation delay, required/delivered energy and departure outcomes.
acceptance_criterion: Charging kWh not mislabeled as missed trips; event definitions have boundaries/units.

activity: Appraise source credibility and evidence strength
method_or_specific_action: Assess authenticity, topology, confounders, physics, validation, service in six separate criteria.
acceptance_criterion: PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/UNKNOWN substantiated by page references; no fabricated average score.

activity: Reproduce decisive published equations/results where feasible
method_or_specific_action: Check units and limiting cases; recreate a documented benchmark before claiming original implementation.
acceptance_criterion: Code+input provenance, conservation and error comparison reported; blocked if missing data.

activity: Map evidence to current SO1–SO3 and mechanism strata
method_or_specific_action: Build what-done/what-measured/what-validated/what-unknown map from extracted study units.
acceptance_criterion: All conclusions trace to study/equation/page and F1–F6 level.

activity: Compare strongest competing methods and claim boundaries
method_or_specific_action: Compare transformer IEC/ODE/FVM, EVSE derating, joint coupling, PINN and service metrics.
acceptance_criterion: No conflation of real input data with measured hot spot or predicted vs observed mobility.

activity: Formulate bounded novelty and falsifiable gap
method_or_specific_action: Check for same-site source evidence and post-2025 work (including RACE Part 2) before gap claim.
acceptance_criterion: Worded 'within searched literature as of ...' with contrary evidence and exact missing experiment.

activity: Draft critical thesis literature chapter
method_or_specific_action: Integrate state/time, measured claims, mechanisms, equations, limits and identified opportunity.
acceptance_criterion: All technical claims trace to primary references and accepted evidence, limitations visible.

activity: Reconcile acquired sources with canonical evidence registers
method_or_specific_action: Use existing SINTEF, STREAM, TUM, EPFL, KU Leuven, OSF, Iowa, OPSD; no false common site.
acceptance_criterion: Per asset original measured/derived/estimated columns, site and rights verified.

activity: Complete TUM seven-vehicle thermal QA
method_or_specific_action: Record 7 SHA256s, decoding, 1023-like codes, sensor semantics, charging event alignment and valid ranges.
output: TUM per-vehicle QA + qualified event table
acceptance_criterion: No anomaly deletion without reason; only valid timestamped observed charging and thermals admitted.

activity: Qualify SINTEF transformer model regime
method_or_specific_action: Preserve original sensors, avoid sheet numeric coercion, units, extreme-heat domain and heldout baseline tests.
output: SINTEF measurement and validation admission report
acceptance_criterion: Same-site component claims bounded; 25.97°C observed ambient max recorded.

activity: Obtain missing STREAM transformer technical parameters
method_or_specific_action: Verify publisher checksum, all 12 station IDs, voltage/power unit/sign and rated nameplates.
acceptance_criterion: No rated utilization or thermal losses until physical units and rating confirmed.

activity: Seek original hot-weather EVSE field data
method_or_specific_action: Request Qatar charger sensor/current/derating logs, timestamp/location/permissions; investigate Li same-site electrical field data.
output: Field access/outreach log and original files if obtained
acceptance_criterion: Each acquisition independently verified; no assumption of access or measured transformer hot spot.

activity: Seek one connected transformer-to-EVSE operating site
method_or_specific_action: Verify dated physical path, AC meter boundary, transformer/EVSE temperature, thermal restriction and service logs.
acceptance_criterion: Actual common site/times/physical topology evidenced or recorded BLOCKED; no stitched fake site.

activity: Build observational identifiability and VVUQ ledger
method_or_specific_action: Assess measured target states, input forcing, IC/BC, confounders, sensor/gap uncertainty and split feasibility.
acceptance_criterion: Component vs coupled fit/validation flags independently justified.

activity: Complete ancillary OPSD demand forecasting if used
method_or_specific_action: Acquire authentic original rows and interpolation flags, run chronological no-leakage baseline; classify as supporting.
acceptance_criterion: No promotion of load forecasting to coupled thermal field proof.

activity: Establish minimum conventional physics baseline
method_or_specific_action: Write physically defensible ODE/PDE/IEC transformer and EVSE state models with units, limiting cases and uncertainty.
acceptance_criterion: Conservation, numerical convergence, initial/boundary conditions and parameter provenance explicit.

activity: Specify falsifiable PINN/hybrid comparison
method_or_specific_action: Prespecify target states, needed real observations, loss functions, training/holdout, baselines and score metrics.
acceptance_criterion: Compare independent heldouts and physical violations, not just training residual or fit accuracy.

activity: Execute data sufficiency gate A/B/C
method_or_specific_action: A no valid thermal data: physics; B component data: component PINN option; C connected data: consider coupled PIML.
acceptance_criterion: Chosen scope supported by observed data/identifiability; explicit no-data fallback.

activity: Test component PINN/hybrid pilot only if admitted
method_or_specific_action: Compare against persistence, calibrated ODE/IEC/FVM where appropriate; frozen independent test.
acceptance_criterion: No ML superiority claim unless independent accuracy/physics/UQ thresholds met.

activity: Quantify physics uncertainty and service implications
method_or_specific_action: Sensor/model/input/parameter uncertainty, sensitivity, transition time and request/delivered electricity; mobility only with evidence.
acceptance_criterion: Separation of thermal state/capability/actual service, conditional scenarios labelled.

activity: Supervisor sign-off on final methodological scope
method_or_specific_action: Document conventional physics or component/coupled PIML and all admitted validation claims.
acceptance_criterion: Clearly states what measured dataset licenses each result, what remains simulated.

activity: Produce systematic references and critical reading bibliography
method_or_specific_action: Complete APA7 DOI-linked references; annotate exact evidence unit and admitted use.
acceptance_criterion: Cites primary texts; avoids unknown authors, placeholder DOIs or unverified quotes.

activity: Prepare evidence-grounded what-others-did memo
method_or_specific_action: Summarize by SO1/SO2/SO3: established, tests, unresolved, existing novelty prior art and limits.
acceptance_criterion: Directly answers Phelan: what other people have done and what we add, with bounded language.

activity: Provide experimental-data and method-choice memo
method_or_specific_action: Summarize qualified data, proof of use rights, parameter identifiability, PINN vs physics gate and results.
acceptance_criterion: Answers conditional PINN instruction without promising field coupling.

activity: Package paper, data and model evidence for review
method_or_specific_action: Share report and reference exports, flow count, extraction sheet, audit, limitations and exact open asks.
acceptance_criterion: No pending task falsely marked complete; useful one-page decision and requests included.

activity: Archive source hashes and update task/evidence statuses
method_or_specific_action: Commit only allowed abstracts/extracts and metadata; preserve restricted PDFs/field raw files in authorized storage.
output: Versioned reproducibility manifest and next checkpoint
acceptance_criterion: All outputs locate source/version/hash; privacy and licenses respected.
